<margin>Mercury</margin> Therefore, when the **Sun** reaches the 20th degree of **Taurus**, it disposes the water of springs to increase and all seeds that are in the earth to grow. **Mercury**, however, through its better part <note>original: "per meliorem partem"; this likely refers to its position when it is dignified or with favorable planets</note>—and if it is entirely thus, then rejoice—concerning that which was said: that its property is such that if it is in the part of a **benefic** <note>A "benefic" is a lucky planet, usually Jupiter or Venus.</note>, it reveals a place that it sets against its friend. ## Of the Mansions of the Moon

<margin>reason</margin> The sages of the Jews say that the mansions of the Moon are 28 in total. And they distribute to all the signs one mansion, [calculated as] 2 and 3 half-degrees of the flower <note>original: "fioris"; this is an unusual technical term, perhaps referring to the fractional parts of a degree</note>. And the [first] sign was of **Aries**. And as the sages of images <note>original: "sapientes ymaginum"; those who practiced astral magic using talismans or "images" corresponding to stars</note> say, when the Moon is in the **Horns of Aries**, it designates cavalry and an intellectual condition, which is not through an image but through a certain [form]. 

Our image now [moves] through the <term>zodiaco</term> <note>The belt of the heavens divided into twelve signs.</note> at a time of greater proper sign, the time of the "support" <note>original: "fercule"</note> of the deeds of the mansions of the Moon which you have from the God of the Moon, let it be according to <term>albuterz</term> <note>A corruption of the name Albumasar (Abu Ma'shar), a famous 9th-century Persian astrologer.</note>. [At the] 8th, which then at the time of the will, at the time of judgment, concerning **Aries**, the time comes up to 12 degrees, 51 minutes, and 2 denarii <note>original: "denarios"; here used as a tiny unit of measurement or fraction</note>, according to what he calls <term>almachi</term> <note>An Arabic astronomical term, possibly referring to a specific star or coordinate.</note>. And this is why all mansions in the time of their figures [act] always by images and carpentry <note>original: "carpentaria"; perhaps referring to the "construction" of a horoscope</note> through the language of the **Tumanorum** <note>unclear; likely a tribal or regional name</note> or the Arabs, and for those through Latin it is the same. 

The sages of the Jews say that through 10 mansions they are "harude" <note>unclear; possibly a corruption of an Arabic term for 'dry' or 'harsh'</note> and they were upon the reward. And these are their names in the Arabic language: <term>alcebaran</term>, <term>aldarau</term>, <term>alhatun</term>, <term>alhaithu</term>, <term>algafar</term>, <term>alhasil</term>, <term>alkula</term>, <term>alhalda</term>, <term>alpzaga</term>, <term>almocar</term>. <note>These are Latinized versions of the Arabic names for the Lunar Mansions, such as Aldebaran (the 4th mansion) and Al-Ghafr (the 15th).</note>

Indeed, they say that when the Moon is considered in the beginning of the middle of its rising, if it was in any **rainy mansion**, one should watch that it happens again just as it is, and so forth. If it was in a **feminine sign**, and even more so if it was in a "diffused" time, it will always cause rain. And for this reason, you ought to provide for the month in its beginning, and more in a strong month, which is said to be before the triple [aspect] of the Sun in its own triple [aspect]. 

And in the signs of **Cancer** and **Leo**, in the sign of the Moon, it gazes at the time of the figure of **Capricorn**. And many in that place [act] as the time is here. And upon the time of the world, when the Sun is at its light, and therefore the Sun reaches **Taurus** with these [planets] toward the head of **Cancer**, it is a time of heat and humidity. We know the mutation of the weather and the multitude in the grain, and its time from the beginning [is] then that which was predicted as its own. 

We say the mutation of the weather [is] toward the heat-bearing dominions, and it will make the heat hasten. And when the time is cold, if you do not hold it except as it is, the Sun is consumed more harshly in dryness and remains as the property was; and it is itself cold and humid, and always at that time. 

And as its [signs] may be made, such as: <term>Albuterm</term>, <term>alcazf</term>, <term>alkala</term>, <term>basarz</term>, <term>albilre</term>, <term>alpargamadd</term>. <note>Another list of Arabic-derived names for lunar stations or planetary conditions.</note> This pertains to the mansions of all things moderately, etc., in matters that I am now speaking of in multitude. <margin>If anyone asks in the matter of baths</margin>

If the Moon joins with the Lord of the Ascendant <note>The planet that rules the zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of the question.</note> and there is any planet falling <note>original: "cadente"; a planet in a "cadent" house is in a position of astrological weakness.</note> away from the Ascendant, it is not said that he will reside there. ### Chapter 12: On Prosperity

If the Lord is such that his dominion is always stronger, that dominion will be established. At the time when the Ascendant is favorable, one should consider the power of the Lord of the Ascendant. If he were in an Angle <note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses, considered the most powerful and active areas of a birth chart.</note> in the matter, he would be <unclear>dliuca</unclear>, that is, in his highest exaltation. If he is in a position of weakness, and with this the <term>horizaic <note>original: "oʳ zaıq"; likely referring to the horizon or the oriental rising of a planet.</note></term> occurs when he rises, then the power can lead to a result. In all things that are sown or predicted regarding baths or the joining of minds, the Lord has reached the proper ratio. When it comes to the reasoning of what you say, the increase of the price is altered. If he were the Lord of the Ascendant or the star leading the way, all things that are moved in that part will increase according to the strength of the joining; the sowing will be completed.

But if the Lord of the Ascendant were not in an Angle, or lacked dignity, or were in a minor position, and if he were in the residence or the fountain <note>possibly referring to the source of a question or a literal water source.</note>, the things sown will only be partially fulfilled. If the Lord of the Ascendant were not in any of the Angles, and was joined with a planet in a falling part, and the Lord was in that Angle which is moving away from the Angle of the dominion, it signifies that the Lord sows [poorly]. 

And if the Lord of the Ascendant were diminished in his motion <note>original: "dimm mō"; referring to a planet slowing down or becoming retrograde.</note>, it signifies a reduction in the price of what is sown. If the Lord of the Ascendant is increased in his motion and was in the Ascendant, and is joined in that motion, it signifies an increase in the price of what is sown. If he has withdrawn from the Lord of the Ascendant, then the matter remains in its current state, signifying neither increase nor decrease.

If the reduction occurs before the sowing, then the sowing will be diminished. If the first decrease signifies the price, look at what remains. If there remains from the first only up to 30 minutes, it signifies a reduction in the Lord of the Ascendant by that amount. If there remains 1 hour and 6 minutes, the reduction will be according to that second amount. If there remains from 6 to 9, the increase of the price will be 30. If there remains from 9 to 12, it is said that the Ascendant signifies heat or cold and is moderate.

### Chapter 12: General Rule

Consider the increase of strength and the appearance of good things. The appearance of bad things and their bad aspects signifies a bad or damaging result.

### Chapter 12: On Interrogations

When interrogations are made by the seeker concerning the lord of the matter, you should say: the man is the Lord of the Ascendant. If the Lord of the Ascendant is in a place of heat or cold, that signifies the nature of the person or the thing sought.

### Chapter 14: On Sales and Prices

When an interrogation is made regarding the price of a place or a sale, let it be seen through the motion. If the Lord is in the Ascendant, it signifies a sale will happen quickly. If the Lord of the Ascendant is not in a position of strength, the sale will not occur without long time and great labor. If the Lord of the Ascendant is joined with a planet in an Angle, it signifies the sale will happen with ease. If he were in a weak position, the sale would be delayed. If a planet that is favorable to him is in the Ascendant, it signifies a quick reception of the price.

<margin>
If the Lord of the day is the ruler and he is favorable to the sale, it will be completed in the matter. 
The sale in the Angle signifies it will happen quickly.
If it is in a falling part, the sale is delayed or diminished. 
If the planet in the Ascendant is the Lord of the price, it signifies the price will be paid.
If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the second house <note>the house associated with money and possessions.</note>, the price is increased.
If the Lord is diminished, the price is reduced.
Look to the strength of the Lord for the final price.

### Chapter 15: On Profit and Trade

If the **Lord of the Second House** <note>The planet ruling the 'house' associated with personal wealth and possessions.</note> is in the **Seventh** from the Lord of the Ascendant, and the Lord of the Ascendant is also the Lord of the Second; or if the Lord of the Second is in a **favorable place** from the Ascendant, such as in a good **aspect** <note>The geometric angle between planets.</note> like a **trine** <note>An angle of 120 degrees, considered very harmonious.</note>, it signifies that what falls to you comes from the part you requested, and there is **profit** <note>original: "lucrum"</note> with the Lord. However, if the Lord of the Ascendant is in the Second House at a long aspect, it signifies that the owner of the thing [the seller] will command you by his own will. If they are in a **bad place**, he will not sell his goods to you.

### Chapter 16: On Delays

Consider the Lord of the Ascendant: if it is in a **water sign** and <unclear>glox</unclear>, it signifies that the "table" <note>likely referring to the finalized deal or the exchange of goods</note> is not yet out of hand, or will be delayed. If the Lord of the Ascendant is in a position of high elevation... <unclear>tagulo</unclear>... just as if by a foot... no.

### Chapter 17: On the Price of Goods

Consider the **Lord of the First** and the **Moon**. If they are in a great and friendly part of the Ascendant, it signifies the **price** <note>original: "pre s" for pretium</note> of the Lord of the thing. If it is in a greatly elevated part in the station of the earth... [it signifies] profit. If it falls from its station in a great part of its **fortune** <note>likely referring to the 'Part of Fortune,' an Arabic calculation in a chart</note>, it signifies that a change is happening... where it remains in that matter.

### Chapter 18: On the Price of Grain

Consider diligently the **entry of the Sun** into its leadership <note>original: "ingressu sol ī mat duct"; referring to the Sun entering a new zodiac sign, usually Aries, to predict the year's economy.</note>. Look to the **Lord of the term** <note>A specific subdivision of a zodiac sign ruled by a particular planet.</note> of the light; if it is in strength, and in its strength there is perfection, it serves the purpose. If it is in the first degree, it signifies with certainty that throughout the **whole year** there will be a **good market** <note>original: "bono foro"; meaning low or favorable prices for buyers.</note>. If the Lords are strong, it is well; if they are without strength, it is a **bad market** [expensive] and a difficult year throughout. And if the Moon is in a choleric sign, it signifies that if they are in proportion... all things shall be **dear** <note>original: "carā"; meaning expensive or high-priced.</note>. If they fall away, it is a **good market** [cheap]. If they are many and weak or corrupted, so shall it be through the whole year.

### Chapter 19: On Fluctuations

Consider... in the quiet of the Sun... which part is closer to the Lord... if the Sun and Earth are in order, the whole year will have a **good market**. Conversely, if they are in a bad form in their parts, then the price is **dear** [expensive]. See the Lord in which signs... it signifies that if it becomes [weak], the price is predicted to be a **good market**; but if it increases [in strength], the price is **dear**.

### Chapter 20: On the Price of Oil

<margin>✙</margin>
### The Division of the World

The three sons of Noah after the deluge <note>The Great Flood</note> divided the whole world into three parts, namely **Asia**, **Africa**, and **Europe**, and thus they expanded their borders. Shem settled in Asia, Ham in Africa, and Japheth in Europe. In **Asia**, there are 14 provinces, namely: India, Arabia, Achaia, Syria, Persia, Media, Mesopotamia, Cappadocia, Palestine, Armenia, Phoenicia, Chaldea, Greece, Egypt, and Libya. In **Africa**, there are 12 provinces, namely: Lydia, Cyrene, Pentapolis, Ethiopia, Tripolitania, Bohemia <note>original: "bifemia"; though Bohemia is in Europe, medieval geographies occasionally misplaced regions</note>, Getulia, Nathabuo, Numidia, the Canary Islands, Eyrea, and Mediterranean Mauretania. In **Europe**, there are 13 provinces, namely: Rome, Calabria, Spain, Germany, Macedonia, Dacia, Dalmatia, Pannonia, Poland, Gaul, Aquitaine, Britain, and Ireland.

---

<margin>co</margin>
### Medicinal Weights and Measures

These are the weights and measures which are customarily used in the medicinal art for weighing various species <note>Refers to "spices" or "ingredients"</note>, from a single scruple up to a pound of seven ounces. These symbols have been collected as follows:

One must begin with the **scruple**. A scruple is the weight of 20 barley grains or 2 <unclear>grains</unclear>.
**℈ i** : <note>original: "℈"</note> This is the symbol for a scruple.
**ʒ i** : <note>original: "ʒ"</note> This symbol represents a **drachm**, which consists of 3 scruples or 60 grains.
**℥ i** : <note>original: "℥"</note> This symbol represents one **ounce**. In the medicinal art, 8 drachms make one ounce.
**lb** : <note>original: "libra"</note> The **pound** in the medicinal art consists of 12 ounces.
A medicinal pound contains 3,240 grains; a fourth part of this is 1,620 grains.
This medicinal system follows the *Antidotarium* <note>The *Antidotarium Nicolai*, a standard medieval text on prepared medicines</note> which begins with "I, Nicholas, requested by..." which provides sufficient instruction for the preparation of all medicines.

---

<margin>y</margin>
### How to Read and Understand Medical Writing

In order to read and understand the writings of physicians and healers that you find in these books of medicines and the symbols, whether they be in English or in Latin, you shall understand that a **pound** is symbolized in three ways: **lb**.
An **half-pound** is written thus: **lb s'**.
An **ounce** is written thus: **℥**.
A **quarter of a pound** is written thus: **℥ iii**.
An ounce is the twelfth part of a pound and is written thus: **s'** and also **ʒ i**.
**Half an ounce** is written thus: **℥ di** or thus: **ʒ iiij**.
A **drachm** is a portion of an ounce and is denoted thus: **ʒ i**.
**Half a drachm** is written thus: **ʒ s'** and thus: **℈ i**.
A **scruple** is the third part of a drachm and is written thus: **℈ i**.
**Half a scruple** is written thus: **℈ s'**.

A scruple represents the weight of a penny; a drachm represents three pence; an ounce represents 24 pence. A quarter-pound is six shillings; half a pound is 12 shillings; and a full pound is 24 shillings. <note>The author uses the monetary system—shillings and pence—as a familiar comparison to help the reader visualize the weights.</note>

A **handful** of herbs <note>original: "wortes"</note> is written thus: **m. i**.
**Half a handful** is written thus: **m s'** or **m i s**.
These are the symbols written in books of Latin.

---

<margin>❧</margin>
### A Remedy for Phlegm

For corruption and phlegm in the stomach:
Take 1 drachm (**ʒ i**) of **ginger** and half a drachm (**ʒ s'**) of **saffron**.
Powder them together and boil them in **vinegar** until the liquid becomes thick.
Take one spoonful of this on a fasting stomach, and do so for three days.

### Concerning Theft and Suspicion

If you wish to know concerning a theft, or about the person who committed the theft, or from what part or direction the suspicion arises, do thus: consider the **Lord of the Ascendant** and its location in the sign. <note>In horary astrology, the "Lord of the Ascendant" represents the person asking the question.</note> Look to the position of the Lord of the second house and the tenth house. If the Lord of the hour is in the 19th sign <note>likely a reference to a specific degree or astrological table</note>, and consider the location of the Lord of the hour in the house of the benevolent planets. If the Lord of the Ascendant is in a fortunate position, the stolen item will remain in its place or be returned. 

If the Lord of the second house is in the twelfth house, add the location of the Lord of the third sign. If it falls in the house of a malefic planet <note>original: "malinol," likely malevolus</note>, the person will desist from their false ways. Behold, the strength of the work depends on the figures of the fortunate and unfortunate planets.
